title: Checks of bench {bench}
intro: These checks only read: show commands and pings, on the bench's consoles, one bench at a time. People watching a console see the task go by.
none: No check has been run on this bench yet.

notice.notOccupant: Only the bench's occupants (and admins) run checks; a locked bench is for admins only.

steps.wake: Enter sent, waiting for an answer

lines.foot: A line open in the application or busy outside it is never opened by the check.

cabling.summary: {ok} as drawn, {wrong} on another port, {missing} missing, {unverified} not verifiable, {unexpected} unexpected
cabling.assumed: one port written on the link, taken for both ends
cabling.stranger: A neighbour that is not a device of the bench.

ping.caption: {count} packets per address. Green: answers; orange: partly; red: no answer.
ping.empty: No router with an active address: nothing to ping.

errors.not_occupant: Only the occupants of this bench (and admins) run checks on it.
errors.locked: This bench is locked ({reason}): only admins check it.
errors.job_running: A job is running on this bench: wait until it ends.
errors.bench_busy: A check is already running on this bench ({name}).
errors.too_soon: The lines of this bench were just checked: try again in {seconds} s.
errors.rate_limited: Too many checks: wait a minute.
errors.no_devices: This bench has no console device.
errors.not_running: No check is running on this bench.
errors.cancel_forbidden: Only the person who started it, the bench's occupants and admins can stop it.
errors.not_allowed: you no longer hold this bench
errors.console_waiting: the console is waiting for an answer ({state}): nothing was typed
errors.probe_failed: the console server could not be asked
errors.probe_unknown: the console server gave no clear answer
